JSD.Settings.DarknessSlider.Label: Darkness Slider
JSD.Settings.DarknessSlider.Hint: Show a quick darkness level slider in the Lighting layer controls, so you can adjust scene darkness without opening the scene config.
JSD.Settings.DarknessSlider.Mode.Label: Darkness Slider — Update Mode
JSD.Settings.DarknessSlider.Mode.Hint: Controls when the darkness change is applied to the scene. Real-time updates on every drag move; On Apply only saves when you click the Apply button.
JSD.Settings.DarknessSlider.Mode.Apply: On Apply (updates when you click Apply)
JSD.DarknessPanel.Title: Darkness Level
JSD.Settings.SceneDefaults.Label: Apply Scene Defaults to New Scenes
JSD.Settings.SceneDefaults.Hint: When enabled, new scenes are created with the values defined in your Scene Defaults configuration. Imported scenes (adventure packs, compendiums) are not affected.
JSD.Settings.SceneDefaults.Menu.Name: Scene Defaults
JSD.Settings.SceneDefaults.Menu.Label: Configure Scene Defaults
JSD.Settings.SceneDefaults.Menu.Hint: Open the Scene configuration editor to define default values applied to every new scene you create.
JSD.SceneDefaults.Saved: Scene defaults saved! New scenes will use these settings.
JSD.Settings.JournalScaler.Label: Journal Scaler
JSD.Settings.JournalScaler.Hint: Enable or disable the journal text/image scaling feature (CTRL + Mouse Wheel) for yourself. This is a personal reading preference and does not affect other players. Requires reload.
JOURNALSCALER.Settings.ScaleImages.Name: Always scale images
JOURNALSCALER.Settings.ScaleImages.Hint: Whether to ALWAYS scale images together with the text. If disabled, hold CTRL + SHIFT while using the mouse wheel to scale images. Turning this off resets any already-enlarged images in open journals back to 100%.
JOURNALSCALER.Settings.ResetAll.Name: Reset All Scales
JOURNALSCALER.Settings.ResetAll.Label: Reset All
JOURNALSCALER.Settings.ResetAll.Hint: Erase all saved text/image scale history for every journal page, including ones not currently open. This cannot be undone.
JOURNALSCALER.Settings.ResetAll.Confirm: This will erase the saved scale for every journal page you've ever resized, including pages that are not currently open. This cannot be undone. Continue?
JOURNALSCALER.Settings.ResetAll.Done: Journal Scaler: all saved scales have been reset.
JOURNALSCALER.Keybindings.ResetScale.Hin: Resets the text and image scale of the journal currently under your cursor back to 100%.
JSD.Settings.ModuleFilter.Label: Module Filter
JSD.Settings.ModuleFilter.Hint: Adds a second search field below Foundry's native Settings search, letting you filter the module list in the sidebar by name only (e.g. typing "jack" hides every module except this one). Does not change the native search's own behavior. Requires reload.
JSD.Settings.GMVision.Label: GM Clear Vision
JSD.Settings.GMVision.Hint: Master on/off for the whole GM Clear Vision feature — the Token Tools icon, the Ctrl+G keybinding, and all of its effects (hidden-token outline, darkness/fog brightening). Turning this off removes the icon entirely, not just its ability to be toggled. Requires the 'lib-wrapper' module to be installed and active. Requires reload.
JSD.GMVision.Keybinding.Name: Toggle GM Clear Vision
JSD.GMVision.Keybinding.Hint: Toggles GM Clear Vision's darkness/fog brightening on/off. GM only; has no effect for players.
JSD.Settings.GMVision.RevealMode.Label: GM Clear Vision — Hidden Token Outline
JSD.Settings.GMVision.RevealMode.Hint: Controls the dashed outline shown over hidden/undetected tokens (only visible to the GM). This is independent from the darkness/fog brightening, which always follows the eye icon.
JSD.GMVision.RevealMode.Always: Always on (while GM Clear Vision is enabled)
JSD.GMVision.RevealMode.Linked: Only while the eye icon is active
JSD.Settings.TextSpacingFix.Label: Fix Blank Line Spacing
JSD.Settings.TextSpacingFix.Hint: Preserves visible blank lines in journals, sheet descriptions, and chat messages, instead of Foundry's default of collapsing them to zero height. World setting — applies the same for every connected user. No reload needed.
JSD.Settings.StatusSort.Label: Sort Status Effects
JSD.Settings.StatusSort.Hint: Sorts the token HUD status effects palette alphabetically within each group. If the active system groups its own effects separately from Foundry core effects (e.g. Daggerheart), each group is sorted independently. Personal preference — applies only to you. Requires reload.
